
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0

    TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        LOCATE AFTER DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#integrationsHandler
        INSERT {
        IconButton {
            id: saverSidebarItem
            objectName: "saverSidebarItem"
            width: parent.width
            enabled: visible
            title: qsTr("Saver")
            font.weight: Font.Medium
            Layout.preferredHeight: visible ? Values.navigatorSidebarItemHeight : 0
            Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width
            navigationHandler: root

            visible: false

            readonly property string configPath: "file:///home/root/.config/saver-remarkable/config.toml"

            function valueFromConfig(body, key) {
                var quote = String.fromCharCode(34);
                var lines = (body || "").split("\n");
                for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                    var line = lines[i].trim();
                    if (line.indexOf(key) !== 0) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    var rest = line.substring(key.length).trim();
                    if (rest.charAt(0) !== "=") {
                        continue;
                    }
                    var value = rest.substring(1).trim();
                    if (value.length >= 2 && value.charAt(0) === quote
                        && value.charAt(value.length - 1) === quote) {
                        value = value.substring(1, value.length - 1);
                    }
                    return value;
                }
                return "";
            }

            function refreshVisibility() {
                var req = new XMLHttpRequest();
                req.onreadystatechange = function () {
                    if (req.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                        return;
                    }
                    var value = saverSidebarItem.valueFromConfig(req.responseText, "show_in_sidebar");
                    saverSidebarItem.visible = value !== "false";
                };
                req.open("GET", saverSidebarItem.configPath);
                req.send();
            }

            Component.onCompleted: refreshVisibility()

            leftPadding: saverSidebarItem.padding + saverSidebarItem.size
                         + saverSidebarItem.spacing

            Image {
                x: saverSidebarItem.padding
                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                width: saverSidebarItem.size
                height: saverSidebarItem.size
                fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
                smooth: true
                source: "data:image/png;base64,"
            }

            Timer {
                interval: 5000
                running: true
                repeat: true
                onTriggered: saverSidebarItem.refreshVisibility()
            }

            onClicked: {
                AppLoadLauncher.requestLaunch("com.saverapp.remarkable", [], {}, false);
                if (typeof root.sidebarMenuClicked === "function") {
                    root.sidebarMenuClicked("Saver");
                }
                if (typeof root.resetFocusIndex === "function") {
                    root.resetFocusIndex();
                }
            }
        }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
